clean_body: Truth, prayer, and action — all in one place. | | August 08, 2026 | == | | | Hi Friend — I am writing this with dirt still under my fingernails. August on the farm is not the pretty season. It is the season of pulling out what is spent. The tomato vines have gone leggy and bitter, the squash gave what it was going to give, and the whole garden has that tired look things get when they have done their work. So this week I have been out in the heat tearing it out by the roots — hauling it off, turning the beds, mending fence, and taking inventory. Not glamorous, but it has to be done now, because it cannot be done later. Winter is coming, and every sign says this one will be hard. The forecasters have their name for it — a Super El Niño, the strongest pattern in decades. It will be rough. So, we’re getting ready. We see a winter coming at True the Vote, too. And I do not mean the midterms. I mean something more than that. There are hard months ahead — for our country and, I believe, for the world — as we grapple with how to go on standing together. How to keep living out that love of liberty God once pressed into Abraham's heart, and then sent him walking toward a country he had never laid eyes on. We are being asked to do the same — into an uncertain peace, across cultural divides that keep on widening, and now into the arrival of artificial intelligence, which is going to reshape work and truth and trust and elections faster than any of us are ready for. And I suspect you see all of it the way I see it. It is good and evil. It has always been good and evil, just seems clearer now. You cannot always tell who is who or what is really what, and yet somewhere underneath it all, you know exactly what you are looking at. What I feel most is time moving. Moving toward something very different. I don’t think any of us can stop it, and I am not certain we are meant to. But which way “different” goes — whether it turns out good — that part is ours. That is the part we will answer for. It’s a high call — to preserve what is good, to stay strong, and to put things in the ground now for a spring we may not see for a while. Which is the other half of what I am doing out in the garden ... clearing out is only the first job. The second is planting. Garlic (if I can find sets, everything is sold out. Ugh!) goes into the cold ground in the fall, and you cover it over, and all winter long nothing happens that anybody can see. Then one morning in spring, there it is. It was working the entire time, down in the dark, where you could not watch it. That is what we are doing at True the Vote right now. Preparing for what is ahead by putting things in the ground now. Preparing for growth. More Americans are awake than ever. 83% of all of America is now saying aloud that our elections need an overhaul. This is the part that encourages me more than anything has in fifteen years. People who rolled their eyes at us in 2010 are calling us now, asking what they can do. Doors that stayed shut for years are swinging open. But being awake is not the same as being connected — and connection is the whole ballgame. A million people who each feel alone are not a movement. They are a million people who eventually give up. So now we have to find one another, and we have to do it fast. That is what all of this is for: LegiTrack — tracking election legislation across all fifty statehouses, so nothing moves in the dark. Scan. Check. Protect. — putting the power to verify a voter record into an ordinary citizen's hand. VoteAlert — so what a citizen sees on Election Day does not die in a parking lot. Photo, video, location, filed from a phone in the moment, reviewed by our team, and posted where the rest of the country can see it. IV3 — where all of this started. Any registered voter can work their own county's rolls, find the records that no longer belong there, and file them through their state's own process. (currently on pause, but soon to be back with new capabilities) True the Vote Now — our sister organization and the Community Platform it provides. And the True the Vote website itself , with all the trainings, the reference guides, the research, the records requests, the state-by-state playbooks, the films, like the upcoming documentary series TRAPPED — all of it free to use, all of it built by us, all of it kept running by people like you. None of that is free to operate. We are also still in court, still paying down legal fees from fights we did not start, and weeks out from launching the documentary series TRAPPED — which includes years of work, thousands of hours, and shows the human cost of vote fraud told by the people who lived it. == I really do not like asking. I know times are tight. I know it. I am not writing to you from some office where the lights are always on and somebody else pays the bill. But if everyone reading this could give even five dollars a month — or heck, even just once — True the Vote would have the budget to scale our initiatives and our team and meet the future head on. == Or once, if that is what you have. Either one, from everyone reading this letter, and we go into the future able to do the work instead of triaging it. I know how small it sounds. Five dollars is a cup of coffee you would have forgotten by lunch. But True the Vote was never built by a handful of people writing big checks. It was built by a great many ordinary Americans each doing one small thing at the same time — which happens to be the way a country gets mended, and the way a garden gets put up before the frost. | == Please help us if you can. Change is coming. I think most of us can feel it and are bracing for it. It’s ok. Do not fear it. And please — please do not tap out because of it. It is going to be different. I will not pretend otherwise. Whether it turns out good is the part we still have a say in. And standing together now, actually together, in one another's lives and not merely in one another's feeds, will without question change the course of history. Maybe we really are the change we have been waiting for somebody else to bring. Maybe this is the time. We think it is. So let us start rising together — and not only by voting. Voting is the floor, not the ceiling. Rise by engaging. And there is plenty to engage in that come along with cleaning up our elections: helping our neighbors find their voice, and making sure that when they use it, somebody actually hears it. That is the work. It is not glamorous. And it has to be done now, because it cannot be done later. Winter is coming. So is Spring. Let us be ready. Keep fighting the good fight. Keep the faith. Never quit. Ephesians 6 FTW! Ever onward — P.S. — every person who opens this letter gives five dollars a month — or even once — we can stop triaging and start scaling, going into the future firing on all cylinders. Please do not assume somebody else will cover your share. The whole idea only works if it is all of us. Thank you for your consideration. == | Make Sure Our Emails Always Reach You UPDATE: We had such a GREAT response to this notice last week. LOTS of people wrote in to say "Hello" and we LOVED it! Thank you!! Your response to the email helps keep up connected! If you missed it.... here's what this is all about. Sending email to our entire list has become increasingly difficult. Our detractors have made a practice of filing complaints about our weekly messages, and those complaints train the filters — which means frictionless delivery is now nearly impossible. And we expect it to get harder, not easier. The most reliable fix is on your end: please whitelist our name. It takes less than a minute, and it works in every email program, old or new. Here's how to do it: 1. Open your email program and find a message from True the Vote — check your Spam, Junk, or Promotions folder if you don't see one in your inbox. 2. If it's in Spam or Junk, click Not Spam (or Not Junk), then move the message to your inbox. 3. Open one of our emails and add the sender address — ** — to your contacts or address book. In most programs you can right-click the sender's name and choose Add to Contacts.** 4. To seal the deal, reply to this email with a quick "hello" — even one word. Nothing signals "this sender is welcome" more strongly than a reply. That's it. This same four-step habit works for True the Vote or any sender you don't want to miss — your bank, your doctor, your church. Thank you for taking a moment to keep our line open. We'll keep doing our part with our email provider, and together we'll stay connected. | ---|---|--- | | == Update your or unsubscribe © 2026 True the Vote 3120 Southwest Frwy Ste 101, PMB 19128, Houston, Texas 77098-4520

Today is one of my favorite days of the year. No, it’s not Election Day — yet. **It’s Berna’s birthday!**
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260808_1_ak.4v8Y13&amount=5&refcode=em20260808-637&t=3&akid=640%2E127862%2EgPxmpK)
My wife, Berna, has been my rock not only throughout this campaign, but for the last 30 years. Through the ups and downs of running a statewide campaign, Berna has been right by my side to support me.
There’s no one easier to celebrate than her. ❤️
But before I can head home for the day and spend time with Berna and the family, I need to ask for your help.
**We’re entering the peak of election season, and my opponent's spending shows it.** MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo and his allies are pouring millions into this race to defeat me, and I’ll be honest: we’re having trouble keeping up.
If we get the resources we need, I know we can pull ahead — but I need to make sure we can compete before I log off for the night.
**Will you chip in $10 today to help get our fundraising back into shape so I can get home to celebrate with Berna?[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_af_20260808_1_ak](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260808_1_ak.4v8Y13&amount=5&refcode=em20260808-637&t=4&akid=640%2E127862%2EgPxmpK)**

— Aaron

clean_body: I looked at the numbers. Your file is empty. Let's fix that right now. | Patriot, I have spent thirty years reading voter data. I know what a healthy file looks like -- and I know what a gap looks like. Right now, your file has a gap. Here's why this matters more than you might think. When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line. Democrats are not leaving blank files. Their activists are filling out every survey, returning every call, and showing up at every meeting. They are building the most complete voter intelligence operation this party has ever run -- and they are doing it right now, while most conservatives are still enjoying their summer. you’ve heard of Cyclospora by now — the “lettuce parasite” that’s made
thousands of Michiganders sick this summer.

RFK Jr., the man in charge of protecting our food supply, went on
television and said it was under control — meanwhile, the case count kept
climbing, and it took federal investigators weeks to even nail down the
source.

I told Kaitlan Collins this week exactly how I feel about that:

[ Abdul ]Abdul talking with Kaitlan Collins on CNN

"I can't wait to sit across from RFK Jr. and actually grill him. Dude uses
big words he does not understand, and I happened to go to medical school,
so I kind of understand them. It's going to be a good time holding him
accountable for all of the grift he has pushed on the American public."

I meant every word. I'm a guy with a doctorate in medicine and public
health. RFK Jr. is a guy who takes his kids swimming in Schitt's Creek —
and somehow, he's the one deciding whether your lettuce is safe to eat.

If I'm in the Senate, I will not let RFK Jr. dodge the blame while
Michiganders are still getting sick. I'll use every tool a senator has to
hold him accountable for the grift.

Mike Rogers would do the opposite. He'd cheer RFK Jr. on and vote to
confirm whoever Trump sends up next — no questions asked. That’s the
difference in this race, and that’s why I need your help to win in
November.

subject: I've spent my career expanding the vote. MAGA’s shrinking it.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Let's be honest about what's happening to the right to vote in this country.
I've spent my entire career in Congress fighting to expand it. I authored the Help Students Vote Act to make sure young people could register and cast a ballot without jumping through hoops designed to discourage them. I helped pass the For the People Act through the House — the most significant expansion of voting rights in a generation.
I have believed, every single day I've served, that our democracy gets stronger every time we make it easier for people to participate, not harder. That belief is under direct attack right now — and I need you with me. Will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us fight back against this assault on the right to vote? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email&amount=25]
The SAVE Act would require Americans to produce a passport or a birth certificate just to register to vote. Think about that for one second. Millions of Americans — students, seniors, married women whose names don't match their birth certificates, working people who have never needed a passport because they've never needed to leave the country — would suddenly find the ballot box locked, and the key is a document they don't have.
Utah just conducted one of the most exhaustive citizenship reviews of any state in this country's history — more than two million registered voters — and found exactly one confirmed case of a noncitizen registering. Zero instances of a noncitizen voting.
So let's call this exactly what it is:
It is not election security. It is election engineering. It is a deliberate, calculated effort to decide the outcome of elections before a single vote is cast — by making sure fewer of the "wrong" people get to cast one.
I did not run for Congress to watch that happen. I built my career trying to open the door to democracy wider, not slam it shut on the people who need it most.
That is exactly why Equal Opportunity Now exists. We are fighting for leaders who understand that democracy isn't real unless everyone gets to participate in it — and who will stand up against every single attempt to rig the rules before the game even starts.
Will you chip in $5, $10, or $25 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect them? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email&amount=25] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE NOW >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email&amount=25]
There is no equal opportunity if the game is rigged. And there is no democracy if they get to decide who's allowed to play.
We won't let them.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

clean_body: [] Let's be honest about what's happening to the right to vote in this country. I've spent my entire career in Congress fighting to expand it. I authored the Help Students Vote Act to make sure young people could register and cast a ballot without jumping through hoops designed to discourage them. I helped pass the For the People Act through the House — the most significant expansion of voting rights in a generation. I have believed, every single day I've served, that our democracy gets stronger every time we make it easier for people to participate, not harder. That belief is under direct attack right now — and I need you with me. Will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us fight back against this assault on the right to vote? [] The SAVE Act would require Americans to produce a passport or a birth certificate just to register to vote. Think about that for one second. Millions of Americans — students, seniors, married women whose names don't match their birth certificates, working people who have never needed a passport because they've never needed to leave the country — would suddenly find the ballot box locked, and the key is a document they don't have. Utah just conducted one of the most exhaustive citizenship reviews of any state in this country's history — more than two million registered voters — and found exactly one confirmed case of a noncitizen registering. Zero instances of a noncitizen voting. So let's call this exactly what it is: It is not election security. It is election engineering. It is a deliberate, calculated effort to decide the outcome of elections before a single vote is cast — by making sure fewer of the "wrong" people get to cast one. I did not run for Congress to watch that happen. I built my career trying to open the door to democracy wider, not slam it shut on the people who need it most. That is exactly why Equal Opportunity Now exists. We are fighting for leaders who understand that democracy isn't real unless everyone gets to participate in it — and who will stand up against every single attempt to rig the rules before the game even starts. Palantir’s moment has passed.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

clean_body: The next three days will decide the course of this campaign. | Fellow Conservative, we are officially less than a week out from our Primary Election. The next three days will decide the course of this campaign. Either we build the resources we need to compete, or we fall behind before the fight has even really started. I earned the Minnesota Republican Party's endorsement on the convention floor, against a crowded field, because grassroots conservatives showed up and refused to let Washington pick this candidate for them. That fight isn't over. Everything we've built comes down to Tuesday. Whoever the Democrats put up this fall, Peggy Flanagan or Angie Craig, they'll have Chuck Schumer's machine and coastal donor money behind them. I need to walk out of this primary with the strength to compete with that, and I can't do it alone. I spent 21 years as a Navy SEAL. I didn't get through my SEAL training by hoping I was ready. I got through it because I did the work before it counted, one day at a time, with people who showed up beside me. I need that from you now. This campaign is powered by grassroots conservatives who love Minnesota and want a fighter representing them, not another name Washington picked for them. We only have three days to make it count. subject: This election is anyone’s game
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=8194%2E582294%2EOLdGNH ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=8194%2E582294%2EOLdGNH ]Chris Pappas for Senate

One point.

That’s what separates me from my opponent. Just one point.

Polling shows that the Republican strategy to pour mountains of cash onto
the New Hampshire airwaves is working.

They’re closing in on what’s shaping up to be one of the most competitive
Senate races in the country.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260808_2.mYw3zP&refcode=em20260808-2&t=1003&akid=8194%2E582294%2EOLdGNH ]I need your help to make up for lost ground. Will you chip in
$5 or anything you’re able to today to help us defend New
Hampshire?

I knew this race wasn’t going to be easy, but we’re in the home stretch of
the election cycle. And it’s anyone’s game.

A one-point margin means we can’t sit back and twiddle our thumbs. It
means we need to get up and strengthen our programs.

As Republican spending continues to work, we need to maximize our ground
game. We can’t keep up with them on the airwaves, but we can beat them by
meeting voters where they’re at.

Defending this seat is going to take a powerful group of grassroots
supporters stepping up to meet this challenge. It’s how I’ve won tough
races before, and it’s the only way we’ll win this time. Together.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260808_2.mYw3zP&refcode=em20260808-2&t=1004&akid=8194%2E582294%2EOLdGNH ]Please, chip in whatever you can

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

subject: “Hey, it's time to vote”

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241001%2E444211%2ExwooQ4)
In Texas, you cannot register to vote online.
There’s no automatic voter registration. No same day voter registration. You have to go down to the county courthouse and make an appointment with the county registrar. Or you have to be lucky enough to run into a certified volunteer deputy registrar (VDR).
Our Powered by People volunteers are those certified VDRs. They’re the ones who go out and meet these future voters where they are — on college campuses, outside of high schools, at concerts, clubs, churches, wherever we can find people.
Not only do we bring them onto the rolls, but we also personally stay in touch with each voter to answer their questions, help them should they be purged from the voter file, and then to nudge them until we can confirm that they have cast that ballot.
We ran this program in 2024. Young people turned out to vote in Texas at a rate of about 39%. **The young people who came through our program turned out at a rate of _over 79%._**
And it just follows common sense. If you have a personal connection with the person who registered you to vote, and if that person is also reminding you, _“Hey, it's time to vote,”_ there's a much better chance that you're actually gonna get that done.
We've got to stay in touch with them. We've got to turn them out. We've got to help them when they confront voter suppression and voter intimidation, which will be coming full force in states like Texas.
It's going to be tough, and we should be clear-eyed about it. But I also believe that with the right attitude and the right work, and with enough of us coming at it, we can overcome this challenge, just as this country has overcome even bigger ones before.
It’s not going to be easy, but we can do this.
We can win in 2026, but only if we continue to register and turn out voters across Texas. [**Can you help support this work by chipping in $3 or whatever makes sense to you today?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260808.FXFHeo&refcode=ema20260808-241001&t=3&akid=241001%2E444211%2ExwooQ4)

Thank you,
Beto

Friend,
Elon Musk isn't done. According to new reporting, the world's richest man is gearing up for a major spending push to help Republicans hold Congress in this fall's midterms — coordinating with other GOP groups and putting his America PAC machine back into high gear.
We've seen this move before. In 2024, Musk's America PAC promised $1 million a day to voters who signed a political petition. It sounded like a lottery. It wasn't.
Here's what's actually happened since:
A federal judge has ordered Musk himself to testify under oath in lawsuits alleging that America PAC misled voters about that $1-million-a-day giveaway. The plaintiffs say the "winners" weren't picked at random at all — they were hand-picked because they'd make good spokespeople for Musk's operation. And in Wisconsin, a state panel reviewing a similar giveaway tied to a state Supreme Court race found that the payments may have crossed the line into bribery.
Let that sink in: a billionaire allegedly dangling cash prizes to manipulate who shows up to vote — and now doing it again, at even greater scale, this time to protect a Republican majority in Congress.
That's why I'm sponsoring legislation in 2027 to explicitly close this loophole in Oregon — making clear that no one, no matter how much money they have, can offer cash prizes, giveaways, or payments tied to voting, petition-signing, or election participation. Oregon should never be a testing ground for schemes like this.
Do you support this legislation?
Add your name to the petition to show Oregon lawmakers that voters — not billionaires — should decide how our elections work. It takes 30 seconds:

Thank you for standing with me,
Tobias Read

Jeanine Pirro stood at a July 2 press conference and said she had "tremendous evidence" that a sixty-seven-year-old Olympic canoeist had forcefully and violently torn up the liner of the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool with both hands. She did not. The Interior Department had already concluded the damage came from a botched installation--rain, wind, a missing sealing product, and a rush to finish before the July 4 celebration--and on July 31 Pirro filed a twenty-page motion asking a judge to make the whole case disappear.
In this special edition of AMPED UP, Cliff Schecter sits down with Glenn Kirschner, who spent thirty years as a federal prosecutor and twenty-four of them in the very D.C. United States Attorney's Office Pirro now runs, to walk through how a bike ride past a peeling pool liner turned into a federal indictment of an Olympian.

Friend, The federal agency responsible for overseeing historic preservation reviews is considering a rule that could allow government agencies and developers to push through projects _without consultation with Tribes or states._ That would put sacred, historic, and cultural sites at risk — while cutting Tribal communities out of decisions that directly affect places of deep cultural and spiritual significance. That's why my Senate colleagues and I are urging the government to work directly with Tribes and states to create a proposal that actually improves the process — without undermining the rights and voices of those most directly affected. name: Sarah McBride
subject: It’s time to end the forever wars
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Donald Trump has continued to launch reckless and illegal military actions against Iran without congressional authorization.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3657%2E21716%2EPog2u_)
Over the past few weeks, Donald Trump has continued to launch reckless and illegal military actions against Iran without congressional authorization.
At a moment when families are struggling with skyrocketing health care costs, unaffordable housing, and the everyday costs of groceries and prescription drugs, **Donald Trump is putting American lives and taxpayer dollars on the line while launching wars that are raising gas prices and causing even more pain here at home.**
**The American people don’t want another generation of forever wars. Neither do I.**
That’s why I’ve voted in support of War Powers Resolutions that would rein in the president’s reckless military actions. But ultimately, Republicans have defeated the measures.

As wildfires destroy hundreds of homes in Eastern Washington and tens of thousands of people remain evacuated, I can't help but think about the work we must do to curb these catastrophes.

Historic fires ravaged Southern California over a year and a half ago, and many people are still waiting on aid to rebuild. This is an issue that affects millions of Americans – and with the warming climate, is becoming more common.

Not only do wildfires affect infrastructure and ecosystems, they jeopardize our national security and economy. This is an issue that is personal to me not only as your representative, but as the co-founder of an organization to find solutions to stop this crisis.

That's what makes my work in Congress so important. I've introduced legislation, the bipartisan Wildfire Response Modernization Act , that would strengthen the wildfire monitoring program we rely on for earlier detection, quicker evacuation, and safety for firefighters.

body:
Washington won’t like this...
|
---
| | | | [](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
---
| | |
---
| | Friend,
My name is Katie Britt, and if it’s alright with you, I’d like to share a little about who I am. **I’m not part of the D.C. cocktail circuit, and I never will be._That’s just not who I am._**

In 2022, I was elected to represent the great state of Alabama in the United States Senate. I became the first woman in Alabama’s history to hold this seat—but that’s not why I ran.

I ran because I’m a _**mom**_ , a _**wife**_ , and a _**conservative**_ who’s fed up with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some Alabama backbone to a broken system.

I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the room—and I’m not backing down.
---
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Before coming to the Senate, I served as the first female president and CEO of the Business Council of Alabama, and before that, I was Chief of Staff to Senator Richard Shelby. **I’ve never shied away from a challenge—and I’ve never forgotten who I’m fighting for.** In every role I’ve held, my mission has been the same: _deliver real results for Alabama families and the American people._
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Before starting my career in public service, I earned my undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Alabama. That experience taught me how to lead, think on my feet, and fight for what I believe in—**and it laid the foundation for _everything_ I’ve done since.**
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
But long before that, I was just a small-town girl from Enterprise, Alabama. My dad ran the local hardware store. My mom taught dance to almost every kid in town. We didn’t grow up with wealth or political connections. **We came from hard work, grit, and doing things the right way._That’s how I was raised, and that’s exactly how I lead._**
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
My husband Wesley and our two amazing kids are my rock. In 2011, a tornado tore through our home and nearly took our lives. That moment changed everything, and reminded me what truly matters. __**Faith** , **family** , and **resilience**.__
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
I’ve lived a life full of hard work, determination, and breaking barriers. There have been challenges and triumphs alike, but I wouldn’t trade any of it.

My story is a testament to what America stands for—the American Dream. From a small town in Alabama, I rose to become my state’s U.S. Senator—a woman who’s breaking barriers and fighting for conservative values every day.

_**_I’m living proof of the limitless opportunity and freedom that define this country._**_

But, I didn’t get here by playing it safe or staying quiet, **and I’m not about to start now.**

The radical Left wants to _silence_ conservatives like me. They want to drown out our voices and push their agenda without opposition, but I’m standing firm.

I’m fighting tooth and nail to keep up and push back hard, for Alabama, for our values, and for every American who believes in freedom.

**The support I’ve received so far means everything, but this fight is far from over.** We need the resources to keep going strong and hold our ground.

**[So, after hearing a bit of my story, will you take a moment to chip in whatever you can afford to help me keep up this fight? The road ahead won’t be easy, but I’ve faced tough battles before. And it would mean the world to have you standing with me.](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)**
|
---
[CHIP IN TO FIGHT WITH KATIE BRITT >>](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Thank you, and may God bless America.

Katie Britt (R-AL)

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, we won’t
lie to you: Winning an election in a battleground state like Pennsylvania
is much easier said than done.

Rallying thousands of volunteers to knock on doors? Not really a piece of
cake.

Spreading Josh Shapiro’s message online and on the airwaves? Definitely
not easy... or cheap.

Defending ourselves from millions of dollars in far-right outside
spending? Certainly not child’s play.

Securing a victory in a state Donald Trump won
twice? Derek...
you get the point.

In a state as competitive and expensive as Pennsylvania, there’s a lot we
have to accomplish to make sure Josh Shapiro is reelected this November.
And all of it will take resources — resources we don’t have quite yet.
Derek, that’s
where you come in.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/5724?t=1001&akid=180%2E245147%2E2bHAfb ]Grassroots donations from hardworking
Pennsylvanians like
you are the foundation of this campaign, and anything you can give today
goes directly towards expanding the efforts of our movement in the final
three months of this race. So please, Derek,

subject: We’re coming for these seats

body:
We have less than 90 days to break the GOP’s grip on power. Here’s where we’re fighting:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260808-2&t=1&akid=3844%2E587540%2ECIsBr2)
Peter,
We talk a lot about primarying asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats in safe blue seats — and we’re not going to stop doing that work.
But there’s another side to what we’re building at Leaders We Deserve: **we’re going all in to flip Republican seats blue this November.**
Here’s where we’re fighting across the country:
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260808_2_r2b.zzb0mq&refcode=em20260808-3844&t=2&akid=3844%2E587540%2ECIsBr2)
**Every one of these races represents an opportunity to break the GOP’s grip on power. Every red seat we flip is a chance to put a real check on Trump’s authoritarian agenda.** That’s why we’re giving this fight, and our candidates, everything we’ve got.
None of our candidates take corporate PAC money. They don’t answer to the ultra-rich donor class. They answer to the people who sent them into the arena — and that’s exactly what makes them the right people to be in it.
**The midterms are less than 90 days away.** We’re up against billionaires, special interest money, and party infrastructure Republicans have spent decades building.
But here’s what they don’t have: a movement of young people who are done being ignored, who are sick and tired of watching the same corrupt political machine run this country into the ground, and who are ready to fight for a future they can actually feel hopeful about.
That’s what we have. And it’s enough to win — if we show up for our candidates and help power them to victory.

Thank you,
David Hogg

Friends,
You’e invited to our Campaign HQ opening!
This Saturday, August 15th at 9:00 AM, **we’re officially opening our Campaign Headquarters,** and I hope you’ll join us.
**Come grab some coffee and donuts** , meet fellow supporters, and celebrate this exciting milestone with our team. This campaign is strong because of people like you, and I can’t wait to bring everyone together as we kick off the next phase of this race.
After the grand opening, we’ll hit the streets for **our first canvass**. We’ll head door to door to talk with voters, share our message, and start building the grassroots momentum we need to win CD27.
If you can join us for the walk, just bring comfortable shoes and your energy. We’ll have everything else you need.
Can’t stay for the canvass? No problem. I’d still love to have you at the HQ opening. Whether you’re walking a route or simply stopping by to say hello, every supporter is an important part of this campaign. All are welcome.
**What:** Campaign HQ Grand Opening + Canvass Kickoff
**When:** Saturday, August 15th at 9:00 AM

body:
I know how hard it is to win in a southern state, and I know that nobody’s been better at it than Roy Cooper
|

Peter, it’s Gov. Andy Beshear of Kentucky. I’m reaching out about my friend Roy Cooper’s race in North Carolina.
As a fellow Democratic Governor from the South, I know what it takes to win in a southern state, and I know Roy Cooper has exactly what it takes.
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1010&amount=5&t=9&akid=2574%2E124072%2EjMXVOD)

subject: Shrinkflation is a choice corporations make

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Next time you're at the grocery store, look closely at the cereal box.
Same price as last year. Same-looking box. But there’s less cereal in it.
That's called shrinkflation, and it is not bad luck. It's a decision made in a corporate boardroom, betting you're too busy to notice they're charging you more for less.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
As the owner of an auto repair shop, I notice when someone tries to sell me a worse part for the same money. As a mom doing the grocery run, it makes me angry.
This is what happens when a handful of giant corporations control what's on the shelf — fewer competitors, less pressure to treat you fairly. It's why I've fought the mega-mergers that swallow up grocery chains, and why I've called out deceptive packaging built to hide price hikes.
My opponent takes corporate PAC money. I don't. That's not a small difference — it's the whole difference. It's why I can say plainly that these companies are nickel-and-diming working families, and mean it.
Will you chip in $3 to help me keep fighting for people who are tired of paying more and getting less? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

Hi Peter, it’s Don Leonard, and Blue Amp Action said I could reach out.

No congressional candidate should have to spend their days refreshing a fundraising dashboard just to prove they're a serious contender. Mike Carey has the energy lobby behind him and corporate PACs that have been writing him checks for twenty years — first when he was their lobbyist and now **as their congressman.** That is not a fair fight. [Split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and me today, and help us fight back.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14495?t=10&refcode=&akid=2805%2E259176%2El882Lk) | [CHIP IN >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14495?t=11&refcode=&amount=20&akid=2805%2E259176%2El882Lk)

Until we overturn Citizens United and get corruption out of politics, this is the game every Democrat running in a district like this one has to play - and we don’t have millions in corporate PAC money to bail us out. I didn't get into this race to spend my evenings asking strangers for money. I got in because Central Ohio's working families have been lied to election cycle after election cycle.

Politicians keep telling us there isn't enough to go around while corporations and billionaires collect their tax breaks, their bailouts, and their trade deals. Meanwhile, people here are working second and third jobs, carrying credit card debt, and choosing between food or their electricity bill just to make ends meet. That isn't how it’s supposed to work.

body:
Charlie saw something rare in JD Vance| | | |
---
| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

clean_body: Charlie saw something rare in JD Vance| | | | | | | Peter, Faith is essential to the survival and success of America. Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth. He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him. He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country. That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith. Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story... It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. Now's the time to restore faith in God and faith in America before another generation drifts even farther from both. And with you, Charlie's mission will reach further -- and touch more young lives -- than ever before. For Charlie, The Turning Point USA Team P.S. body:
The polls had him up by 20. Now, he's panicking.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/txBpql_e6Mj?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,
A lot can change in a month.
Around the Fourth of July, public polling showed Josh Shapiro with a commanding lead of more than 20 points. The pundits called the race over. His allies told their donors he was unbeatable.
[**Now, this is a single-digit race.**](https://us.list-manage.com/HAPtnsJ3M98?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
PennLive [**reported this week**](https://us.list-manage.com/16tSJLPbQX1?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd) that we are slicing into Shapiro’s lead.
**The trend is unmistakable: poll after poll shows Shapiro’s support eroding while we continues to climb.**
---
| [HELP US CLOSE THE GAP](https://us.list-manage.com/18sa_dI1gKg?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | And here’s the part Shapiro really doesn’t want you to know:
We are closing the gap while being outspent by more than $4 million on television in the past month alone. Shapiro is spending millions and still losing ground. Every dollar he pours into TV ads buys him less and less — because Pennsylvanians aren’t buying what he’s selling anymore.
You can even see it in his ad strategy. His own polling must be telling him the same thing ours is: he’s losing ground with working Pennsylvanians.
Why is this happening? Because Pennsylvanians are feeling it where it matters most — in their wallets.
❌ Electric and utility bills keep climbing, with more increases coming this summer

❌ Property taxes continue to rise, forcing families out of homes they spent a lifetime building
❌ Pennsylvania has the 5th highest tax burden in the country — and the economy just dropped to 47th
No amount of TV ads can change that.
**Shapiro can spend $4 million a month on television, but he can’t lower your electric bill from a TV studio.**
---
| [STAND WITH STACY](https://us.list-manage.com/eGehSQt7AFP?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | Here’s what we know: the momentum is real, the gap is closing, and the majority of voters still don’t know who I am. That means every new voter we reach is a voter who moves our way. But reaching them takes resources.
Shapiro’s spending millions trying to stop the bleeding. We’re closing the gap on a fraction of his budget.
**Imagine what we could do with just a little more.**
**Will you chip in right now and help us keep the momentum going?**
---
| [CHIP IN NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/sxLLd34aMWh?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | We have less than 100 days to go.
The trend is clear. They counted us out.
They were wrong.
Thank you for standing with us.
---
|
---
| |
_P.S. Shapiro spent $4 million on TV ads last month and still lost ground. We’re closing the gap on a fraction of his budget because our message is breaking through._[_**Can you chip in today and help us finish the job?**_](https://us.list-manage.com/sOi_fRGSoXS?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)

body:
The best way to fight these attacks on voting and elections is by registering as many new voters as we can and getting them to vote in November.
Our program costs $3 per new voter. Join the movement with $30 or more right now to register new voters and more >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=080826_1&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Voter registration is a core part of how we fight back against suppression, folks.
How do we do it? We maximize your impact by focusing on the underserved and ignored portions of eligible voters. The unregistered, eligible citizens. Previous voters who let their registration lapse. Anyone who feels disregarded and disconnected from the political process.
Why them? Candidates and their political campaigns target those most likely to turn out. They hyper-focus on "persuadables" and "reliable partisans." Rather than trying to compete with their resources, we maximize your impact by speaking directly to Americans who feel left behind as they lose their fundamental rights.
We drive these eligible citizens to participation by helping them understand the stakes and showing how their vote matters . That's why our voter registration efforts are so important: Everyone should vote and feel invested in the outcome.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=080826_1&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=080826_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=080826_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=080826_1&amount=50]

Unfortunately, we don't have anywhere near the resources to blanket the country with our efforts. Each election cycle, we target specific states where our efforts will make the greatest difference, like Nevada, North Carolina, or Michigan.
The key is getting these disenfranchised people -- always the first target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed over the last few years.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- is the whole ballgame. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register new voters ahead of registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=080826_1&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

subject: Trump & Hegseth Are Burning through America’s Critical Defensive Weapons.
body:
They are leaving our troops dangerously exposed
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Trump& Hegseth Are Burning through America’s Critical Defensive Weapons.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta2b6e58e-40e2-4e0c-9908-65bbc7efa86a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth started a war with Iran, and instead of focusing on targeted, high-impact, strategic attacks, they just dropped as many shitloads of whatever weapons they had, wherever they could, as quickly as they could. So they could act macho and make ape noises at news conferences. **And now we’re running out of these weapons. Because Trump and Hegseth apparently can’t count, and used the weapons far more quickly than they replaced them.** **[And our troops are dangerously exposed.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc23f0b28-b214-4bbe-a3ae-45f3a1579063/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **[Tell Congress: “Stop Trump and Hegseth from Dangerously Depleting our Weapons, and Leaving our Troops Exposed”](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te20f5567-1bc8-4686-9069-d9343c2abf96/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T787d611c-309e-49ce-a648-88107a2d2f30/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The U.S. has reportedly [burned through](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb565f9a7-eee4-4b67-bbb4-a6a4e991523c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) about 65% of its Patriot interceptor stockpile and more than a third of its THAAD interceptors. These weapons cost millions of dollars apiece and can take years to replace. Meanwhile, Iran can deploy huge numbers of relatively cheap drones and missiles, forcing us to burn through enormously expensive interceptors to stop them. Trump and Hegseth should have seen this coming. Ukraine has spent years demonstrating how large numbers of cheap drones can overwhelm expensive traditional defenses. They didn’t need a crystal ball. **They just needed to read a newspaper. Literally ANY newspaper.** This has been front-page news for years. Congress must stop giving Trump and Hegseth a blank check to keep going and allowing their stupidity to be weaponized against the rest of us. **[End this war. Bring our troops home. Rebuild America’s defenses. NOW.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tce985371-29af-4f7a-be6e-d75632940849/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **[Tell Congress: “Stop Trump and Hegseth from Dangerously Depleting our Weapons, and Leaving our Troops Exposed”](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9d0abc09-1d21-4036-86ea-ebd67db4fba2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

body:
We’re so close to the end of this Primary election. In these last days, I’m focused on traveling the state and talking directly to voters.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f04fcd795bef/can-you-help-us-reach-more-voters-10123280?e=f59034ca3e)

| | | | | | Hi Peter,We’re so close to the end of this Primary election, and so close to the start of the General election. In these last days, I’m focused on traveling the state and talking directly to voters.
The role of State Treasurer is important, and we need a Democratic candidate with the experience and ability to do the job. **That’s why over 100 elected officials, including Congressman Mark Pocan,**[****](https://us.list-manage.com/FukILq9Qguj?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)[**have endorsed my campaign for Treasurer.**](https://us.list-manage.com/dXHI3EmrAdr?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)**** They know that I am the progressive option in this race, that I have done the work to win in November, and that I have the experience necessary to succeed once in office.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/tKUsu6GRCcC?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |
But no one can win an election alone, and that’s why I’m asking for your help in the final days of this primary campaign. This last weekend, it is critical that as many voters as possible hear my message. That’s why my team is expanding the reach of my digital ads in this final push, but we need help to reach as many voters as possible.
Can you chip in today to help me expand the reach of my election weekend ads?
[**If we raise an additional $5,000, my ads can reach more voters in even more parts of the state. And with only four days until polls close, now is the most impactful time to expand our ads. Can you chip in $25 today to help me win this election?**](https://us.list-manage.com/11jMqkS7z4p?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
I’m so grateful to everyone who has been on this journey with me, and with your support, we will finish strong this Tuesday!

Let’s get this done! Thank you for your support.
Thank you,Dylan

| **Dear Friends:

_Tuesday, August 11th is Primary Election Day._**

I’m hoping you take the time to vote and here’s why it’s important:

We have open primaries in Vermont, which means you can vote in either the Democrat or Republican election.

_**I think having TRULY independent Vermonters vote too, will lead to more mainstream or more middle of the road choices in November.**_

Let me give you a couple of examples of why voting in this primary is important...

_Take the Chittenden County State's Attorney AND Sheriff races. In all reality whoever wins the Democratic Primary will win the general election, because right now, there are NO other candidates running._

_**These races are consequential for public safety issues and unfortunately may be decided by just a handful of primary voters, if you don’t show up to vote. **_

So, regardless of whether you’re a Democrat, Republican, or Independent, you need to VOTE on August 11th.

_**And, if I’m not on the ballot you choose and want to vote for me, you can always write me in.**_

So, to sum it all up:

**No matter what your political views, whether you've voted in every election, or this is your first time, your voice matters more in primaries than you think.**

__Please vote on Tuesday.__

Thanks

_**Governor Phil Scott **_

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. We've been serving Coloradans for decades.

Folks, whether it’s beer service or public service, the fact remains: **we’ve been serving Coloradans for decades.** Way back when, I was a laid-off geologist who took every scrap of my savings — _and a big risk!_ — and opened Colorado’s first brewpub, the Wynkoop. Wynkoop wasn’t just about serving beer. It was a place where people came together, sat across from folks they didn’t always know or agree with, and still managed to build relationships and work out their differences. Then I was elected to serve as Governor of Colorado, and in 2020, folks like you helped me flip Colorado’s Senate seat blue. Through it all, our focus has remained the same: Putting Coloradans first and getting sh*t done. There’s no sugarcoating it: Donald Trump fired all 22 members of the National Science Board.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
This is the governing body overseeing the National Science Foundation, one of the most important scientific institutions in the United States — and he fired all of them. At once.
The National Science Board exists for a reason. It oversees billions in federal research funding, advises Congress on science policy, and helps ensure taxpayer dollars support real, evidence-based innovation.
Now that independence is being stripped away.
Let me say this clearly: When political leaders start dismantling independent science institutions, it doesn’t just hurt scientists. It hurts all of us — because that means fewer medical breakthroughs, less climate research, slower progress on cancer treatments, degraded pandemic preparedness, and more.
As a microbiologist and educator, take it from me: Science only works when it is allowed to be independent, transparent, and guided by evidence — not politics.
But what we’re seeing now is a systematic effort to replace expertise with loyalty, and it’s happening at the highest levels of government.
This is exactly why I’m running for Congress. Because we need leaders who will defend science and protect vital institutions like the NSF.
But I can’t take on that fight alone. We’re heading into a critical stretch of this campaign, and we need the resources to compete against entrenched interests that are perfectly comfortable ignoring science. So I’m asking you: Can you chip in $10 or whatever you can today to help me fight for science, facts, and the future of research in America? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
When we let science lead, people thrive. Let’s put facts back in charge — and build a Congress that reflects reason, reality, and hope.

With Senate control at stake here in North Carolina, President Trump, JD Vance and Stephen Miller have all been coming after me with baseless attacks. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: We won, Peter!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Hope and joy are in the air — I couldn’t be prouder of this grassroots team and more confident about our fights ahead.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260808-6574-footer&t=1&akid=6574%2E420207%2EFoIB_G)
Peter,
What a huge week for our progressive movement! I felt so much hope, joy, and energy in the air this week, and I owe it all to this grassroots team for getting our campaign across the finish line.
**I won my primary in Seattle with 84% of the vote, and I want you to know this win belongs to all of us**. Every volunteer, every organizer, every person who showed up and fought right alongside me. You showed what it looks like when people come together to stand up for their communities. Not corporations, no special interests, just the people.
In Washington state and beyond, the people chose fighters to protect and defend their communities up and down the ballot.
**Congratulations to Liz Berry, Jaelyn Scott (who won the primary for my old State Senate seat, and I couldn’t be prouder!), Gerry Pollet, Darya Farivar, Colleen Melody, Ian Birk, Teresa Mosqueda, and Jorge Barón here in Washington. And congratulations to Abdul El-Sayed and Will Lawrence in Michigan, and Tom Perillo in Virginia!**
Each of these leaders ran campaigns grounded in the same values we fight for every single day: Medicare for all, standing up to corporate power, and making sure working families have a real voice in the halls of power. My Medicare For All PAC invested over $350,000 in Abdul’s race, all raised from small dollar contributions. Fuel from people, for the people, to take back the power from dark money special interest groups.
And that investment means our movement just got a lot stronger. All of these wins are the result of an organized, people-powered movement that refuses to give up.
**And Peter, the stakes have never been higher than they are in this midterm cycle.** We have a real shot at taking back the House and Senate this November. The energy is there. The momentum is here. And this week proved it. We’re going to flip seats across the country and put the issues facing working families front and center, where they always should’ve been — and we’re going to do it together.
I have never felt more hopeful about our fights ahead. But hope alone won’t move this work forward. We have to keep our foot on the gas between now and November.
[**If you’re able, will you pitch in $3 or whatever you can today to help keep me in Congress fighting for the issues that matter most to our communities — Medicare for All, affordable housing and groceries, an end to forever wars, and humane immigration reform?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260808-2.1v-kVW&refcode=em20260808-6574&amount=3&t=2&akid=6574%2E420207%2EFoIB_G)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260808-2.1v-kVW&amount=3&refcode=em20260808-6574&t=21&akid=6574%2E420207%2EFoIB_G)**
Thank you for everything, Peter. Now let’s get back to work!
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260808-6574-footer&t=22&refcode2=6574_420207_FoIB_G&akid=6574%2E420207%2EFoIB_G)**

body:

# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2425%2E791427%2EA442sZ)
Friend, we are so sorry to send you yet another email, but we hope you know we wouldn’t reach out if it weren’t critically important.
**With just three days until the final votes are cast in this race, we are still behind on our fundraising goals.**
The harsh truth is that we need to raise an additional $15,000 this weekend in order to afford our Get Out the Vote efforts. And we’re not going to hit that goal if folks simply scroll past this email rather than chipping in.
Maybe you can only afford $10. Maybe you can only afford $1. Maybe you can give more. The amount doesn’t matter as long as everyone chips in. That’s what it means to be part of a mass movement rather than relying on billionaires and corporate donors.
